description:
An infamous pirate mining vessel, the Serene Squall once did what few other ships and crews have ever accomplished: they seized the U.S.S. Enterprise! Under the command of Captain Angel, who was undercover aboard the Enterprise at the time, the Squall lured Captain Pike and his ship into an asteroid field, where it was captured by an energy net. Angel took command of the Enterprise, whose crew was transferred to the Squall, now under the command of Captain Remy, to be sold into slavery.

However, with the help of his enviable cooking skills, Pike staged a mutiny by appealing to the Squall’s disgruntled crew. He and his officers took control of the ship and used backdoor codes to disable the Enterprise. Angel abandoned their crew and fled, leaving them to face a lengthy jail term in a Federation maximum security prison. The Squall itself was impounded.

But surely this is not the end of the story, and it won’t be long before such an infamous ship is out of jail, out for vengeance, and out for plunder.
